title: gomphandra quadrifida var. triplinervis
intro: Gomphandra quadrifida var. triplinervis, commonly known as Whitebark, is a plant species in the family Gelsemiaceae. It is a shrub or small tree native to the tropical forests of Asia, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Whitebark include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, which can aid in reducing fever and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Whitebark include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
